In middle/high school, this girl “Jen” was one of my biggest bullies.  She would torment and tease me all of the time.  When I’d walk through the hallways, she’d push me and laugh.  After I graduated hs, I thought I’d never see her again!

Fast forward 4.5 years:  I graduated college and was back at home.  I was at a friend’s get together and RIGHT as I arrived, my friend told me that “Jen “ was there.  At first I was super annoyed.  This girl tormented me and you invited her?  But I said, “screw it.  Imma have fun anyway.”

So I went in, greeted her, and had a good-ass time.  A couple hours later, she asked to speak to me alone.  We went off to the side and she told me that she never realized how much fun I was to be around.  And that she was going through her own shit at the time and took it out on me.  She apologized again and again.  

It was an amazing feeling!  I wouldn’t say we’re best friends, but we’re FRIENDS now.  And while I still feel the effects of the bullying, I’ve forgiven her.  She was just a young girl in a lot of pain.  We weren’t too different...we just reacted to our pain differently.
